🌱 Streakly Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Effective date: June 25, 2026
App: Streakly
Package name: com.caucoraseko.streakly
Developer: Claudio Valenzuela / Caucoraseko
Contact: claudio@aisosu

This Privacy Policy explains how Streakly handles information when you use the app. Streakly is a habit tracking app designed to help users create habits, track daily progress, build streaks, view statistics, and manage simple reminders.

1. Information we collect

Streakly may process information needed to provide the app functionality, including:

  • Habit information created by the user, such as habit names, icons, categories, completion dates, streaks, and points.
  • App progress data, such as completed days, current streaks, longest streaks, and statistics shown inside the app.
  • Anonymous authentication information generated by Firebase Authentication, such as an anonymous user ID.
  • Cloud sync data stored in Firebase Firestore when synchronization is enabled or available.
  • Reminder preferences, such as whether daily reminders are enabled and the selected reminder time.
  • Basic technical information needed to operate, secure, debug, or improve the app.

2. Local storage and cloud sync

Streakly uses a local-first approach. Habit data may be stored locally on your device so the app can work quickly and remain usable even when cloud sync is unavailable.

Streakly may also sync habit data with Firebase Firestore under an anonymous user account. This allows progress to be saved in the cloud and restored or synchronized where supported.

3. Firebase services

Streakly uses Firebase services, including Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore. Firebase may process technical and usage-related information according to Google's own privacy and security practices.

Streakly does not use Firebase to sell personal information.

4. Notifications

Streakly may request notification permission to send daily habit reminders. Notifications are used only to remind users about their habits. Users can enable, disable, or manage notifications through app settings and device settings.

5. Information we do not intentionally collect

Streakly is not designed to collect sensitive personal information such as government ID numbers, biometric data, health records, financial account details, precise location, private messages, contacts, photos, microphone data, or camera data.

6. How we use information

We use information only for legitimate app purposes, including:

  • Providing habit tracking functionality.
  • Saving and displaying daily progress, streaks, points, calendar activity, and statistics.
  • Synchronizing habit data with cloud storage when available.
  • Sending optional habit reminders.
  • Maintaining app reliability, debugging issues, and improving the user experience.
  • Complying with legal, security, and platform requirements.

7. Sharing of information

We do not sell personal data. Information may be processed by service providers used to operate Streakly, such as Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, hosting providers, or platform services required for app distribution.

Information may also be disclosed if required by law, security obligations, or to protect the rights, safety, and integrity of the app, users, or third parties.

8. Data retention and deletion

Habit data may remain stored locally on your device until you delete the app data or uninstall the app. Cloud-synced habit data may remain stored in Firebase for as long as needed to provide the service.

You may request deletion of your Streakly cloud data by contacting us at claudio@aisosu.fi. Please include enough information to help identify the relevant anonymous app data where possible.

9. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information handled by Streakly. However, no system is completely secure. Users are responsible for protecting their own devices and accounts.

10. Ads and payments

The current version of Streakly does not include third-party advertising.

Streakly may show a preview of future premium features. If paid features, subscriptions, or in-app purchases are added in the future, this Privacy Policy may be updated to describe any additional data processing.

11. Children’s privacy

Streakly is intended for general productivity and habit tracking use. It is not specifically directed to children under 13 years of age, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

12. International users

Streakly may be used from different countries. By using the app, you understand that information may be processed in countries where the developer, hosting providers, Firebase, Google, or other service providers operate.

13. Your rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing of your personal data. To make a request, contact us at claudio@aisosu.fi.

14. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as Streakly evolves. When we make changes, we will update the effective date at the top of this page.

15. Contact

For privacy-related questions, requests, or concerns, contact: claudio@aisosu.fi.
